ei.title: Language as a Cultural Practice and Action
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Language is a cultural resource available for people to use. We do things with words, as the philosopher J. L. Austin reminded us decades ago. Even when we speak or write to ourselves, our very choices of words, as well as our underlying intentions and desires, are influenced by the social contexts in which we have seen, heard, or experienced those words, intentions, and desires before. Linguistic anthropologists, therefore, maintain that the essence of language cannot be understood without reference to the particular social contexts in which it is used. But those contexts do not stand apart from linguistic practices or somehow "contain" them, as a soup bowl would contain soup. Rather, social contexts and linguistic practices mutually constitute each other. For this reason, language should be studied, Alessandro Duranti writes, "not only as a mode of thinking but, above all, as a cultural practice, that is, as a form of action that both presupposes and at the same time brings about ways of being in the world."

But those contexts do not stand apart from linguistic practices or somehow "contain" them, as a soup bowl would contain soup. Rather, social contexts and linguistic practices ④<u>mutually</u> constitute each other. For this reason, language should be studied, Alessandro Duranti writes, "not only as a mode of thinking but, above all, as a cultural practice, that is, as a form of action that both presupposes and at the same time brings about ways of being in the world."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①reminded(상기시켜 주었다) ②choosing(←choices 명사) ③maintain(주장하다) ④mutually(상호 간에)
det.analysis:
① reminded: the philosopher J. L. Austin reminded us → 과거형 동사, 적절
② choosing: our very choices of words에서 our(소유격) 뒤에는 명사 choices가 와야 함. 동명사 choosing은 부적절 ←정답
③ maintain: Linguistic anthropologists maintain that → 동사, 적절
④ mutually: mutually constitute each other → 동사 수식 부사, 적절
det.tip: 소유격(our) 뒤에는 명사 필요: choices(명사) vs choosing(동명사)
